title: Levenda's archival assessment of MJ-12 and his talk with Stanton Friedman
place_text: National Archives / Library of Congress; Contact in the Desert

tellings.quote: Those documents to me look real.

plain: The MJ-12 documents, papers said to describe a secret panel of top US officials set up to deal with crashed alien craft, look real, according to the author Peter Levenda. He says this after his own research in places like the National Archives and the Library of Congress, and he tells of discussing the papers with the physicist and UFO researcher Stanton Friedman at Contact in the Desert, a UFO conference. In his words, "Those documents to me look real." If they are real, the US government would have had a secret group managing alien crashes since the 1940s or 1950s.
